{{Top}}
[[File:Four_Sages_of_Dwartii_statues.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Bronzium sculptures.]]
'''Bronzium''' was a solid, durable substance. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] statues of the [[Four Sages of Dwartii/Legends|Four Sages of Dwartii]] held in his [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|office]] were made of bronzium,<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> as were the statues of many of the greatest [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|jediarchives|Jedi Archives}}</ref> and the [[Lost Twenty/Legends|Lost Twenty]] displayed in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="ROTSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> Bronzium was also used in droid manufacture; a bronzium finish covered [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] chassis,<ref name="CharEnc">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] were armored with this material.<ref name="ROTSn" />

[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] often used bronzium to craft weapons such as [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]] and [[Kashyyyk long-gun/Legends|Kashyyyk long-guns]].

Some [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattataki]] wore a [[bronzium sun disc]] on their waist to maintain their [[Rattataki sash|sash]]. [[Asajj Ventress]] was at one point one such individual.
